english.title: Exceed a temporary 50mph speed restriction on a motorway in contravention of a Local Traffic Order - ACD
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a motorway, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..), subject of an Article and Order, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL TRAFFIC ORDER..), at a speed exceeding 50 miles per hour, in contravention of a temporary maximum speed restriction
english.legislation: Contrary to the above Local Traffic Order and section 16(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See also H6515 for the manned equipment version of this offence.
(iii) The summons MUST indicate the Order No. and the specific location e.g. (at, by or between marker posts No....) etc, on the special road.
(iv) A notice of intended prosecution IS required for this offence.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant drove **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on the **(..SPECIFY DIRECTION..) bound carriageway of the **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY NAME..) motorway at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) subject of an Article and Order, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE AND ORDER..), at a speed in excess of a temporary speed restriction of 50mph.

The speed recorded by means of **(..SPECIFY THE INSTRUMENT TYPE..) was **(..SPECIFY THE SPEED..) miles per hour.

other.penalty:

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three to six penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.
